citation.source: Commonly cited culinary conversion: 1 pinch ≈ 1/16 tsp of fine table salt
citation.note: Genuinely imprecise by convention, not just uncited — cooks don't measure a pinch. Also varies by crystal size (fine vs. coarse), which this repo doesn't model as a separate entity yet — see QuantitySchema's doc comment (ingredient.ts).

metadata.notes: The recipe ROADMAP.md's capability test named as blocked, now run end-to-end: WASH/PEEL/CUT/FRY the potato (low heat, long duration — soft-fried, deliberately not browned, real technique); CRACK/BEAT/SALT the egg; COMBINE merges the two fried-potato and beaten-egg instances into ONE new tortilla_mixture instance (both consumed — verify in the log: potato-1 and egg_cracked-3 are both gone from final inventory); FRY the mixture, FLIP it, FRY the other side. Onion-free (sin cebolla) — no onion entity exists in this vocabulary yet, and it's a legitimate traditional variant on its own, not a workaround.
metadata.washNote: Added 2026-08-15: this recipe originally went straight to PEEL on a raw potato — mechanically valid (PEEL has no statePrerequisites entry at all) but skipped a real prep step every other potato recipe in this repo already includes (see salted-fried-potatoes.json's wash/peel/cut order). Found by scripts/validate-recipe.ts's new prepAdvisories heuristic (recipe-explain.ts) flagging it directly, not by manual re-read.
metadata.oilTempCNote: Added 2026-08-15: the potato FRY step originally set only heatLevel: 'low' with no real oilTempC, so recipe-explain.ts's new fry-timing-vs-geometry check (cut-dimensions.ts + heat-penetration.ts) couldn't reach it — no real number to check against. 135C is the midpoint of fry.json's own already-cited 'low' band (120-150C, Harold McGee's On Food and Cooking, see fry.json's parameterNotes) — not a new citation, reusing one already in this repo. Checked directly, not assumed: at 135C, a real 'sliced' potato (3-5mm, cut-dimensions.ts) takes 10.0-111.2s for its center to reach fork-tender depending on exact thickness/oil coverage — comfortably below this recipe's own 900s, confirming validate-recipe now reports zero timing advisories for this step where it previously couldn't check at all.
metadata.instanceIdNote: targetInstanceId 'egg_cracked-3'/'tortilla_mixture-4' aren't in initialInventory — they're ids CRACK/COMBINE spawn at runtime (recipe-runner.ts's spawnCounter), matching the same convention salted-fried-potatoes.json already uses for potato_peel-1. validate.ts logs a NOTE for these, not a failure — see that script's own comment on why spawned ids can't be verified statically.
